name: flow-metrics-review
description: Analyze flow metrics to identify delivery bottlenecks and improve throughput. Use when the user says "flow metrics", "why is delivery slow", "cycle time analysis", "WIP analysis", "throughput review", "what's our lead time", "DORA metrics", "where is work getting stuck", "Kanban metrics", or wants to diagnose delivery performance using data - even if they don't explicitly say "flow metrics review". Based on "Making Work Visible" by Dominica DeGrandis (WIP limits, flow blockers, time thieves) and "Accelerate" by Forsgren, Humble & Kim (DORA metrics, delivery performance indicators).
